contexts.text: God hath gathered my reproach () = ... that Rachel was no longer barren, and thus was not dead.
I will show the kingdoms thy reproach () = their infernal loves...
God hath... delivered us to reproach (). Explained.
Trust in the shadow of Egypt shall be for disgrace () = no faculty of resisting evils... Shame, and disgrace = their state when they are accounted as vile on account of evils.
Ignominious vomit () is predicated of falsified truth.
Not treat the neighbour with contumely and ignominy. Signified.
